tableLines.line: "Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Darius.
📓 Codex: Emberhold split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Sam speaks at Ashford's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
◈ THE EMBASSY — the table is set, the bundle is served, and the galaxy ate from it. The deed is done — the seat still waits on the deeds.
◈ THE TABLE — between now and the seat, the world holds its breath. The wild can still take your food — but it cannot take your people.
Riders from The Red Table are telling the deer story again — with your name attached this time.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
🧳 Word of Haven’s the televised games is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: The Red Table has bound itself to Emberhold. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.
🧳 Word from The Red Table: Wren was killed — Sofia did it, they say. (The truth: dead is dead; the killing part is gossip.)
🥣 Lucia of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
Lucia waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
💔 A faction of Ashford has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Omar.
🧳 A traveler says Ashford burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table II is the new fire.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. Not yet. The table is being set for those whose deeds are done, and yours are not done. The ledger still wants: wave-3 monsters faced. The climb is not over.
🥣 Lucia of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
Lucia waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~1000 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
A runner from The Red Table II, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Indispensable. Other villages send envoys now. They need what you know.
🧳 Word from The Red Table: Sofia is dead, and Kira and Oscar both claim the fire. The Red Table is choosing — or fighting.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~1120 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table II bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
You don't know what that was. An inflatable rat the size of a house. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
A house-sized inflatable rat, holding a sign.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the southeast. They trampled 2 garden plots into mud. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
